implementation_rationale: Preview diff uses labeled 'old → new' format for short text fields rather than unified diff — appropriate for non-code content
CLI edit mode uses standalone huh forms rather than the full TUI app to keep the edit flow simple and non-interactive-terminal-dependent
confidenceRank comparison uses < operator instead of == to generalize the filtering gate across all presets uniformly
tradeoffs: History Detail stored as JSON string (not typed struct) trades type safety for schema flexibility and simpler serialization
--clear-overrides without a preset flag keeps the current preset rather than resetting to default — preserves user intent
codebase_patterns: Spec files are dated and stored under docs/superpowers/specs/ in the worktree
Memory loop code is split across memoryloop/ (core logic) and memorylooptui/ (TUI layer)
Confidence filtering uses a rank function (confidenceRank) for ordered comparison rather than string equality
writing-plans skill is invoked only after all architecture and file references are fully resolved
